_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#20. The same 1-element HEX8 deck is run with a correct RESULT DESCRIPTION and then with each of the three fields spoiled in turn. DIS 'structur' exits 1 with 'expected 1 tests but performed 0' from core/utils/src/result_test/4C_utils_result_test.cpp line 198 — the run completes, the mis-spelled name is never echoed (DIS_ARM_ECHOES_THE_TYPO=0) and no test is reported WRONG (DIS_ARM_REPORTS_A_WRONG_TEST=0), so only the COUNT betrays it. NODE 99999 exits 1 with 'Node 99999 does not belong to discretization structure' and QUANTITY 'banana' with "Quantity 'banana' not supported in structure testing", both from structure_new/src/utils/4C_structure_new_resulttest.cpp. A typo in a verification block therefore cannot fake a passing run. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Node 99999 does not belong to discretization structure
Quantity 'banana' not supported in structure testing

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the DIS arm: spell the discretisation correctly. The entry then matches, the count check passes and the count diagnostic vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the NODE arm: name a node that exists. The node throw vanishes and the fixture must go red.
remove the pathology from the QUANTITY arm: ask for a quantity the structure tester supports. The quantity throw vanishes and the fixture must go red.
